messages:
Julian: Heads-up: during the eu-canary yesterday I saw merged p95 for /v1/respond spike from 0.2s -> 1.6s while p50 stayed ~0.18s. Chart looks like the merged percentile pulled in a tiny tail.
Mei: Do you have the routing timeline? Any quota fallbacks or new route enabled?
Julian: Canary ramped 10%->40%->80% between 02:10-02:20. We also had a soft quota in eu enabled which may cause fallthrough.
Rashid: Can you paste sample counts? small contributor counts are usually the smoking gun with t-digest merges.
Julian: Snapshot: total_count ~ 1400, merged_p95_count reported 14, slow-route count=5 with latencies ~2.7s. Raw histogram shows 4 outliers.
console-team: Confirmed pipeline: we compute per-route t-digests then merge for the panel. Fast and cheap but fragile when contributors have very different counts.
ingest-bot: info: routing-change detected for /v1/respond (2026-09-14T02:12Z)
alerts-bot: alert: merged_p95_delta > 400% for /v1/respond (detected 2026-09-14T02:13Z)
Mei: Two immediate fixes: (1) show per-route p95 next to merged p95 in the panel, (2) mark merged pctls as low-confidence when any contributor < 25 samples.
Rashid: For alerts: change paging rule to suppress merged-p95 pages when merged_sample_count < 50 and instead emit per-route p95 alerts. That'll cut false-positives during ramps.
Julian: Agree. I can reproduce locally by simulating 95/5 split with slow tail on the 5%. Repro and logs attached in the issue.
console-team: UI plan: add provenance pill "merged from N contributors (low confidence)" and a one-click "Show per-route" drawer. Also add tooltip: "Merged percentiles come from t-digest merge; small contributors can skew tails."
Mei: Also consider changing smoothing order: compute percentiles from merged raw buckets after smoothing instead of smoothing percentiles. More compute but avoids inversion artifacts.
Rashid: Long-term: implement a short-lived exact histogram cache for recent windows so "Exact recompute" is cheap for oncall. And add an ingest diagnostic flag that logs contributor centroids when p95 jumps > 25%.
console-team: We'll start with UI affordances + sample-count guard. We'll prototype a provenance API that returns contributors list + counts so UI can decide whether to recompute exact.
Mei: Action items: Julian -> attach repro artifacts; console-team -> provenance pill + per-route toggle PR; Rashid -> alert rule change + diagnostic flag; infra -> consider exact-hist cache RFC.
Julian: Thanks. One more note for runbook: add a short checklist "If p95 jumps but p50 stable: 1) check per-route counts 2) check routing/quota changes 3) enable exact recompute"
console-team: Good call. We'll add that to the oncall runbook and link it from the pill.
Rashid: I'll also add a fallback in alerting that downgrades severity if merged confidence is low.
Mei: OK closing the triage for now. Reopen if we see regression after the UI + alert changes. :white_check_mark:
